svg.title: Cash and two working-capital measures
svg.desc: At the end of 20X2, FA has cash of 50 (unit: KRW 100 million). Net working capital is current assets 400 − current liabilities 200 = 200. Operating net working capital in this case is receivables 150 + inventory 200 − trade payables 120 = 230, excluding cash and financial borrowings. It is not cash on hand or funds immediately available for payment.

g.font-family: Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans, sans-serif
g.text: Operating measure excludes cash and debt.
